description: Ways to pay for Underpriced AI scans. Without a choice it lists the credit packs (5 to 250 scans, from $3; credits never expire) and, for a signed-in user, their balance. PACK_5, PACK_15 and PACK_30 can be bought here: with one it returns a Stripe Checkout link for that user. PAY_AS_YOU_GO turns on the meter for a signed-in account: 25 cents for each photo pricing, billed monthly to the card on file; pay per answer with no plan needed, or the top-up past the plan's scans for a plan subscriber. Larger packs and monthly plans (whose unused scans carry over one month) are on the pricing page. Anonymous callers get the pricing page link.

pack.description: A pack to buy, or PAY_AS_YOU_GO (the meter: 25 cents for each photo pricing; no plan needed, or the top-up past a plan's scans). Leave empty to see the options and the balance first.
